scientific_integrity: The exponential representation and one-factor Gamma matching are sourced to previous work. The new mathematical statement is the increasing-index signed Kolmogorov profile and its sharp constant; no external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform signed CDF error O(a^-1) proven for real Bessel shape a>=4 with a-to-infinity, one Gamma factor; no optimized finite-a error bound, no uniform relative-tail theorem, no simultaneously varying factor count. General Edgeworth bibliographic coverage requires independent review.
title: Sharp high-dimensional Gamma error for Bessel exit times
